scope: local offline reserve adapter repeatable bundle builder and transport fixtures; no runtime admission or preparer invocation

validation.finalChange: Added refusal on bundler warnings, then reran all three builder checks including the 23 nested adapter checks.
checks: Two builds must produce identical bytes and source/dependency fingerprints; static external imports must be builtin.
Build graph excludes node-gyp-build, bufferutil and utf-8-validate after disabling optional native websocket helpers.

Generated CommonJS guard accepts a builtin and refuses package names, absolute/relative file names and invalid values before loading them. This test exposes the actual guard through a separate derived fixture.
Actual bundled CLI runs outside the checkout with PATH only, no installed dependency directory and strict stderr checks.
Existing output directories and invalid arguments refuse with exit 78 and a fixed diagnostic; retained bytes remain unchanged.

limitations: Local evidence does not claim independent cross-platform reproducibility or admitted Linux/runtime artifacts.
The manifest hashes the esbuild JavaScript API file, not its native executable; Node version is checked but its executable is not independently pinned.
Builtin-only imports are not a network sandbox. This guard does not prove the absence of every dynamic ESM resolution path.
The source and lockfile are selected locally; package dependency selection and runtime admission still require review.
No compiler, key generator, validator, RPC mutation, canonical deployment or retained stability attempt was invoked or changed.
Prior failed packaging prototypes and test logs remain retained.
